description: This file defines custom formatters for specific SRS estimator configuration and result classes within the ocudu namespace, including formatting logic for resource parameters, channel matrices, and timing information.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::srs_estimator_configuration>
classes.description: Custom formatter for ocudu::srs_estimator_configuration, formats resource and slot information, including CRB and RE details.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::srs_estimator_result>
classes.description: Custom formatter for ocudu::srs_estimator_result, formats timing, power, RSRP, noise variance, and channel matrix information.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for the formatter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the given object into the provided context, applying specific formatting rules.
